10378|5d1f9ab4.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|5d1f9ab4.text: Treat the wind rider well as it takes you to your destination.  May your ancestors watch over you $N.

11046|28b8dee2.name: Whuut
11046|28b8dee2.text: Why should I pace myself if this is working?

11798|a2b097f2.name: Bunthen Plainswind
11798|a2b097f2.text: Would you like a flight to Thunder Bluff, courtesy of the Cenarion Circle?

11802|ef8483c2.name: Dendrite Starblaze
11802|ef8483c2.text:
Greetings, $c.  You are welcome in Nighthaven, as well as all of Moonglade.  The Cenarion Circle welcomes all beings who respect the authority and command of nature.

While you are here, please be sure to preserve the balance in all things.  Disturbances are not welcome here, and our wardens are trained to cease all hostilities without question.

12042|cf843c85.name: Loganaar
12042|cf843c85.text: Even within cold, stone walls such as the ones that shelter this town, one may find tranquility and peace.  In fact, you may find them everywhere you are... simply look inside yourself for such balance.

253849|6ace422f.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
253849|6ace422f.text:
Lorthuna is performing some sort of ritual up there. She may be trying to bring down the wards!

The help we sent for has not yet arrived, but we'll just have to manage with what we have. When you are ready, let me know and we'll go confront her.

259118|b3bb7fbb.name: Muln Earthfury
259118|b3bb7fbb.text: I am Muln Earthfury of the Earthen Ring. What brings you before me today?

260628|e754d42e.name: Valennia Stormfist
260628|e754d42e.text:
<Valennia winces in pain as she shifts to look at you.>

Don't look at me like that. I'll be fine. Despite the best efforts of the High Elder's fretful healers, I'll be up and ready to fight again in no time.

Now be gone with you... don't let this old soldier hold you up. The winds will bring you good fortune on your journey, I know it.

264078|adb68b1b.name: Sutara Plainstalker
264078|adb68b1b.text:
It is my honor to handle supply and provisioning for the Earthen Ring. 

My stock is limited at present, but check back with me often and I may have new equipment and supplies available for purchase.

267327|d8b814ea.name: Kagil
267327|d8b814ea.text: Agol ne wirsh ver ne vandar novaedi veld algos nevren? Va se ras uden vrum bor garde?

275270|fb00a823.name: Windshapers Dockmaster
275270|fb00a823.text: All travelers bound for Mulgore should depart here.

276171|1e85fa3a.name: Oura Stormspinner
276171|1e85fa3a.text: We shen'dorei have need of additional cloth to replenish our supplies. Any donations you make would be put to good use, and surely raise your esteem with the Windshapers.

3033|febb65fa.name: Turak Runetotem
3033|febb65fa.text:
Welcome, my sister.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to teach you.

It never hurts to reaffirm one's place within what I like to call the Great Balance.  As preservers of this balance, we must strive to continually keep our minds clear and our hearts strong.  Training helps us in this regard.

3036|d1e27715.name: Kym Wildmane
3036|d1e27715.text: $N, how may I further your training in the eyes of the Earth Mother?

3157|1605f087.name: Shikrik
3157|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

3173|1605f087.name: Swart
3173|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

3194|57542108.name: Vel'rin Fang
3194|57542108.text: I make sure Sen'jin is supplied with materials from the local beasts. It is an honorable role.

3216|1672ee12.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|1672ee12.text:
Naive fool. The Burning Blade IS the Shadow Council! There are many cults and organizations under the Council's rule, but all of them are just extensions of their will. I may lead the Burning Blade, but I am still just as much a pawn to the Council as you are to me!

Look at the Searing Blade--most of them think they are becoming the next rising group of powerful warlocks that they will replace the Shadow Council.

3216|2e9c14b6.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|2e9c14b6.text: Haha! Save for their leaders--the satyr, Bazzalan, and the warlock Jergosh--yes, all of them. That is why I constantly send Thrall's worshippers at them. It gives Thrall the impression that I am weeding out the evil in the bowels of his great city. The victory is in reality two-fold: kill Thrall's faithful and test the strength of those in the Searing Blade to see if they are truly worthy of joining me.

3216|9353e287.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|9353e287.text:
Ah, one of our own. It is good to see our numbers are growing so rapidly that I can no longer keep track of the faces of our members.

That fool Thrall thinks I am working hard to cleanse the image of warlocks and prove we are his servants. Idiot! The Burning Legion will make ash of this entire world after it drains it completely.

3216|e0c203bc.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|e0c203bc.text: I will make it known to you. You are obviously already proving yourself in our ranks to become a lieutenant so quickly. Perhaps you can return to me later and I will have tasks for you. The council adores those skilled in the arcane, but servants of all kinds are always welcome, no matter their profession.

3320|ae78a458.name: Soran
3320|ae78a458.text: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

3368|5a0b913d.name: Borstan
3368|5a0b913d.text: I have the finest meats in Orgrimmar.

3389|5612724d.name: Regthar Deathgate
3389|5612724d.text: We have our duties, $c.  Duties to the Horde.

3391|8f749700.name: Gazlowe
3391|8f749700.text: Thrall paid me and my boys well for helping out with the construction of Orgrimmar, so I decided to set up a port here. We do most of our business through Booty Bay and Baron Revilgaz.

3419|dabc0513.name: Apothecary Zamah
3419|dabc0513.text: For our people to survive, we must study the ways of nature and learn its secrets.

3430|0e16a4d2.name: Mangletooth
3430|0e16a4d2.text:
You! $R! Come here. <snort>

Time is short, and my end <snort> is near. Mangletooth shall win; you will see. <snort>

My capture can still aid <snort> my people. The Razormane tribe is more powerful than the Bristlebacks!

The Horde looks to find out who leads the raids on their people. You <snort> shall aid Mangletooth in return for the information only I know. Mangletooth can help you! <snort> But you must help Mangletooth.

3442|ef9d74c5.name: Sputtervalve
3442|ef9d74c5.text: Director Riddlevox put me in charge of the Union's shredder development program. Few months on the job and I'm already in hot water! I could use your help, $N!

3453|48c11c0f.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
3453|48c11c0f.text: Something I can help you with, $N? There's a shipment I've got to see to otherwise.

3934|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Boorand Plainswind
3934|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

4949|9a2b62b8.name: Thrall
4949|9a2b62b8.text:
All members of the Horde are equal in my eyes, $N. We have all suffered many burdens, and if it were not for wisdom and honor, then we would be no better than the Scourge or my people while our blood was tainted by the demon Mannoroth.

It is your duty to aid the Horde and to defend our way of life. But it is also your duty to know when quarter and compassion should be given to friend and foe alike.

Understand this well. This is the new Horde, not some demon-spawned army who lack freewill.

5784|8f9f7a5f.name: Waldor
5784|8f9f7a5f.text: Even here in the wilds, you seek out learning. Your drive for knowledge is an admirable trait.

6251|86b6c1ef.name: Strahad Farsan
6251|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

6791|60c5da07.name: Innkeeper Wiley
6791|60c5da07.text: Come in, come in. Just don't sit too close to the stove. It hasn't exploded yet today, but just to be safe I think you should sit elsewhere.

1069-accept.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
1069-accept.text:
Spider egg omelettes are a new fad in Booty Bay!  The problem is... Booty Bay's got no eggs.

I smell an opportunity!

In Windshear Crag and Sishir Canyon, in the Stonetalon Mountains to the northwest, lives the deepmoss spider.  Bring me its eggs and I'll pay a bundle!

In Windshear Crag, the eggs will be clustered under what trees remain.

In Sishir Canyon... well, if you have a weak stomach then maybe you should just collect the eggs at Windshear Crag...
1069-accept.title: Deepmoss Spider Eggs

1483-accept.name: Sputtervalve
1483-accept.text:
The Venture Company stole many of the best goblin minds, but from time to time, we get the opportunity to steal some back.

A while ago, the Venture Company outfit in the Stonetalon Mountains hired Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle--a gnome! Their other engineer, Ziz Fizziks, was so taken aback by this, he pleaded with me to find him new employment with the Tinkers' Union. I set him on a few tasks, but he might need help.

Maybe you could look in on him for me? He's stationed at the western edge of Windshear Crag.
1483-accept.title: Ziz Fizziks

1492-complete.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
1492-complete.text:
A small enough crate. Yes, I should be able to find room for this aboard the ship. It sails with the next tide, I trust this is soon enough? Excellent. Let me just enter it into my ledger.

All taken care of! Good day to you, $c.
1492-complete.title: Wharfmaster Dizzywig

1492-progress.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
1492-progress.text: You seek passage on the next ship, or have some item you wish to send aboard it?
1492-progress.title: Wharfmaster Dizzywig

1516-complete.name: Canaga Earthcaller
1516-complete.text:
Excellent. Your success shows that you are prepared.

Of all the elements, earth represents the foundation of all things. It is your strength, your stamina, and your patience. Earth will protect you, but only if shown the proper respect. Like the other elements, even earth can be fickle. Earth is the basis for life, and by observing its laws, you will gain greater wisdom. Never forget the secrets earth shares with you.

I shall make a sapta for you now, and by accepting it, you will realize your path.
1516-complete.title: Call of Earth

1516-progress.name: Canaga Earthcaller
1516-progress.text:
Patience is earth's greatest virtue. The earth witnesses the cycle of all things: the mountains becoming deserts; rivers becoming canyons. The earth is the most stubborn and wise of all the elements and it does not tolerate impatience.

The earth beckons you now because a time of conflict draws near. When you return to me successful, then you shall be that much closer to being made whole.

Others will be envious of your wisdom and hate you for their ignorance.
1516-progress.title: Call of Earth

1517-accept.name: Canaga Earthcaller
1517-accept.text:
A sapta is a drink created to bind our spirits to the elements. Fused with magic, the potion will allow the strong willed to see the elements as no one else can. Your spirit will be connected to the element the sapta was created for, and only a select few $c know the recipe.

The sapta is always drunk in a holy place, and never anywhere else--remember that.

Seek out Spirit Rock southwest of here--it is found at the end of the Hidden Path. Drink your sapta there, and... well, you shall see.
1517-accept.title: Call of Earth

1517-complete.name: Minor Manifestation of Earth
1517-complete.text:
Ah... $N... pleased is the earth to have you here.

Bound together in body and spirit, you will go forward knowing that the mountains are your strength; the plains, your patience; and the world itself your essence.

Standing before the earth humbly is all that is required of you for you to pass this rite. But the others are not as passive. They may be chaotic and often violent, but such is the nature of the elements. Dual natures opposing one another, you must come to learn these things intricately.
1517-complete.title: Call of Earth

1518-accept.name: Minor Manifestation of Earth
1518-accept.text:
Take this rough quartz from me and bring it to Canaga Earthcaller as proof of our meeting. He will craft a totem for you, and this pebble will be the heart of it. As small as it may seem, you will come to find that size does not matter, and that even the smallest of things can outlast many others.

Be patient, $N. Remain strong. And seek wisdom. This is what earth asks of you. In the end, you shall become one with the earth--respect it as it shall respect you.
1518-accept.title: Call of Earth

1518-complete.name: Canaga Earthcaller
1518-complete.text:
Excellent!

The totem I will craft for you is more than a symbol of your status among $c--it has abilities beyond that. One use of the totem is as a focus for spells. Those spells are tied to the earth, and as you earn greater and greater wisdom, more of the earth's abilities will be made accessible to you.

The trainers will know when you are ready for greater knowledge.

But for now, take this earth totem...
1518-complete.title: Call of Earth

1518-progress.name: Canaga Earthcaller
1518-progress.text:
I wish to be the first to welcome you fully to the first of four paths that will forever lead you in your destiny.

If you have the stone the earth gave to you, I will give you the totem it promised.

If not, then be gone with you until you have found your way.
1518-progress.title: Call of Earth

27-accept.name: Turak Runetotem
27-accept.text:
$N, I have been following your progress with much delight.  You are most assuredly developing yourself into a valued protector of nature.

The time has come for you to learn more about one of the various animal aspects that Cenarius has blessed us with the ability to change into - one that affords you command and mastery of the water.  For this, you must travel to the village of Nighthaven in Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze of the Cenarion Circle there.  He will guide you further.
27-accept.title: A Lesson to Learn

3281-accept.name: Gazrog
3281-accept.text:
You may have killed the raptors, but the silver they stole must be recovered!  I have reports that the raptors have a large grouping of nests south of Ratchet, known as the Raptor Grounds.  It is likely that they brought our stolen silver there.

Go to this raptor haven and search for the stolen silver.  When you find it, return it to me.
3281-accept.title: Stolen Silver

5041-accept.name: Thork
5041-accept.text:
That attack on the caravan contained supplies we desperately needed.

You've been brave enough to take on the Razormane tribe so far, and I will ask you to do so again, but this time, I wonder if I could ask you to keep your eyes open for some of our lost supplies. You can probably find them throughout their camps, the quilboar getting fat off their dishonorable acts.

The people of the Crossroads would be in your debt.
5041-accept.title: Supplies for the Crossroads

5041-complete.name: Thork
5041-complete.text: Haha! Thank you, $N! This will help us greatly. You're a boon to the Crossroads and to the Horde. If there is anything I can do for you, please, let me know.
5041-complete.title: Supplies for the Crossroads

5041-progress.name: Thork
5041-progress.text: How goes your search for the supplies, $N? I trust the quilboar fall under your strength easily.
5041-progress.title: Supplies for the Crossroads

5726-accept.name: Thrall
5726-accept.text:
One thing I will not tolerate are traitors in our midst, $N. But I would be a fool to play my hand so early--it would not sufficiently cut the corruption out of our lands and only cause the infection to grow worse.

But you, a young adventurer, could go places my agents could not... could learn the truth... could find the true head of the beast.

If you are brave enough, then enter Skull Rock to the east of Orgrimmar, find a lieutenant's insignia off one of the Burning Blade there, and return to me.
5726-accept.title: Hidden Enemies

5726-complete.name: Thrall
5726-complete.text:
Good, $N! The spirits be praised, perhaps you are the one who will finally put my greatest fears to rest! Who would suspect someone so young and so brave would rise up and champion our cause? You remind me of myself when I was younger. I will ensure that you are justly rewarded for your efforts if we both survive the coming storm.

But there is time for more praise later. You've not accomplished anything in comparison to what you will face... but this is a good start.
5726-complete.title: Hidden Enemies

5726-progress.name: Thrall
5726-progress.text:
Do you have the insignia yet, $N?

It will be a vital tool in infiltrating what I believe is the greatest threat to the Horde, and finally finding peace in our new home.

You will learn how intricate a web men and orcs alike can weave when they are motivated by greed and power. The hidden agendas, the corruption, all of it will become clear. You will find yourself in the midst of a war you never knew existed.
5726-progress.title: Hidden Enemies

5727-accept.name: Thrall
5727-accept.text:
Now let us see if this insignia you found is worth the effort.

There is a warlock within the city who believes he has my trust. He does not know that I realize where his true loyalties lie. He is in fact the leader of the Burning Blade. But do not rush off to do battle with him; he has a purpose, and we shall use him against our enemies.

Take this insignia to him in the Cleft of Shadow here in Orgrimmar, speak to him and see if he believes you are one of his own, then return to me here.
5727-accept.title: Hidden Enemies

5727-complete.name: Thrall
5727-complete.text:
Excellent! Most excellent, $c!

What you have done this day is only the first step in a much broader foundation--a foundation that we will build the destruction of the Shadow Council on, once and for all.

Tell me all he said... and leave not one word out--it may be more important than you realize.
5727-complete.title: Hidden Enemies

5728-accept.name: Thrall
5728-accept.text:
Hmm, leaders of the Searing Blade... this concerns me most. If they are the ones of value to Neeru, then those are who we must target first. This satyr... Bazzalan, and the other Neeru mentioned--what was he, a warlock?--must be slain.

Return to the Cleft of Shadow and enter Ragefire Chasm, $N. Find these two leaders of the Searing Blade, and kill them. But be careful not to let Neeru know it was you who did this. You must retain your identity as one of his sisters in arms.
5728-accept.title: Hidden Enemies

5761-accept.name: Neeru Fireblade
5761-accept.text:
The primary task set upon me by our great Warchief is to root out the creatures responsible for infesting our lord's great city with demonic influence. The Burning Blade is one threat, but there are others; the Searing Blade for instance, who make their home in Ragefire Chasm, secretly attempting to subvert innocent members of the Horde.

If they are to be stopped, then their leader must be slain--a Felguard named Taragaman the Hungerer.

Kill him, and his heart will appease Thrall, of this I'm sure.
5761-accept.title: Slaying the Beast

6126-accept.name: Turak Runetotem
6126-accept.text:
You're now ready to learn about poison and the power we as druids have over it, $N.  Cenarius has blessed us with the ability to purge even the most foul of poisons with but a mere incantation.  This gift is not to be taken lightly... and to ensure you learn this lesson, you'll work to address the effects of poisonings as a layman would.

Travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze; he awaits your arrival to begin your lesson.
6126-accept.title: Lessons Anew

6126-complete.name: Dendrite Starblaze
6126-complete.text:
Greetings young $c, I'm glad to see you ready and eager to learn about the curing of poisons.

While most druids in the past were put through pre-planned trials, your work will involve no such thing.  There has been a rash of animal poisonings at the Crossroads in the Barrens, and they're unable to bring it under control.  Someone there has requested Moonglade for aid, so we are sending you there to aid them.  This is no exercise - the work you'll do is quite real.  Bear this in mind.
6126-complete.title: Lessons Anew

6127-accept.name: Dendrite Starblaze
6127-accept.text:
Dreadmist Peak to the northwest of the Crossroads is most likely a primary candidate as to the source of the spread of the poison.  Its airy peaks have pools of water that influence the weather patterns.  I suspect the water is now tainted by the demon-worshipping Burning Blade.

Use this sampler to draw water from the pool at the very top of the peak.  Once filled, deliver it to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads.  He is the one that requested our aid, and you will work with him to address this malady.
6127-accept.title: The Principal Source

6541-accept.name: Thork
6541-accept.text:
Have you ever been to Ashenvale, to the north? The horde has recently set up an outpost on the Zoram Strand there, and we can always use some new recruits to help defend our new fronts.

If you think you are up to it, see Kadrak in the northern Barrens, at the watch tower. He is heading up the Ashenvale campaign and can give you further orders.
6541-accept.title: Report to Kadrak

744-accept.name: Eyahn Eagletalon
744-accept.text:
$N, my brother soon stands before Chief Bloodhoof, and it is my honor to make his headdress for him.

I want to ask a favor of you while I finish tanning these leather straps. There is not time for me to find enough feathers, and I was wondering, would you gather more for me?

You can find feathers of the correct size from the harpies residing far to the north and northwest of Thunder Bluff. I need only 6 azure and 6 bronze feathers to complete the design.
744-accept.title: Preparation for Ceremony

768-complete.name: Veren Tallstrider
768-complete.text:
Ah, these are very nice pieces.  They'll make fine leather goods.

Here, $N.  Take this in trade...
768-complete.title: Gathering Leather

768-progress.name: Veren Tallstrider
768-progress.text: Hello again.  Have you been hunting?  Do you have skins for me?
768-progress.title: Gathering Leather

769-complete.name: Veren Tallstrider
769-complete.text: Ah, good.  Thank you, $N.  My heart swells with pride to see youths interested in the craft of leatherworking.
769-complete.title: Kodo Hide Bag

819-accept.name: Unknown
819-accept.text:
A small placard on one of the ends of the keg says,

"Chen Stormstout-

May your spirit be raised and always raise your spirits."
819-accept.title: Chen's Empty Keg

819-complete.name: Brewmaster Drohn
819-complete.text:
Well, I'll be...

This was one of Chen Stormstout's kegs. He traveled with Rexxar a long time ago. I haven't seen or heard about him in a kodo's age. I appreciate you bringing this to me, $N.
819-complete.title: Chen's Empty Keg

821-accept.name: Brewmaster Drohn
821-accept.text:
Would you like a taste of Chen's namesake? Ahh, the stormstout is a mighty brew. Chen taught the recipe to my mentor, and my mentor passed it on to me. I'll need you to get me a few things, but I can tell you this: the kick is worth it.

Bring me 5 savannah lion tusks from any savannah lion, 5 plainstrider kidneys from any plainstrider, and 1 thunder lizard horn from any species of thunder lizard. That should do the trick nicely.

You can find these ingredients throughout the Barrens.
821-accept.title: Chen's Empty Keg

844-accept.name: Sergra Darkthorn
844-accept.text:
Your first prey will be easy.

The plainstriders to the east have been harassing our food supplies and have become a nuisance.

Put down the plainstriders and return to me with their beaks.
844-accept.title: Plainstrider Menace

844-complete.name: Sergra Darkthorn
844-complete.text: Very good, $N.  With the plainstriders gone we'll have an easier time keeping our supply chains intact.  And I hope you learned a few tricks out there in the Barrens, for your next prey has a little more fire in its blood than the plainstriders...
844-complete.title: Plainstrider Menace

844-progress.name: Sergra Darkthorn
844-progress.text: Have you collected the plainstrider beaks?
844-progress.title: Plainstrider Menace

845-accept.name: Sergra Darkthorn
845-accept.text:
The zhevra, although not the fiercest beast in the Barrens, are a shade tougher than the plainstriders.  Don't worry -- we'll send you against bigger prey in good time, but for now your teeth could use a little more cutting.

Hunt the zhevra to the north and south, and collect their hooves.  Bring them to me and perhaps we'll next send you against something tougher.
845-accept.title: The Zhevra

845-complete.name: Sergra Darkthorn
845-complete.text:
Not bad, $N.  Those zhevra hold a lot of strength in their legs.  A sharp kick from them can knock even a tauren on its haunches!

It looks like you have some strength in you too.  Are you ready for a real challenge?
845-complete.title: The Zhevra

845-progress.name: Sergra Darkthorn
845-progress.text: How many zhevra have you slain?
845-progress.title: The Zhevra

848-accept.name: Apothecary Helbrim
848-accept.text:
The oases of the Barrens hide a mystery.  Life energy flows from their waters, invigorating the plants and beasts that drink it.

Invigorating, and altering.

There is a mushroom that grows near these oases.  Its spores hold properties that we, the apothecaries of Lordaeron, find useful.

Bring me these spores and you will earn our gratitude.
848-accept.title: Fungal Spores

848-complete.name: Apothecary Helbrim
848-complete.text:
Ah, yes.  These are good specimens.  Potent.

I am Forsaken, and we honor our contracts.  Here is your reward, $N.
848-complete.title: Fungal Spores

848-progress.name: Apothecary Helbrim
848-progress.text: Do you have the spores, $N?  There is a concoction I must send to my associate in Thunder Bluff, which requires the spores...
848-progress.title: Fungal Spores

850-accept.name: Regthar Deathgate
850-accept.text:
The centaurs have plagued the Tauren for years.  And recently, the Kolkar centaurs of the Barrens have grown into a real threat.  Normally they were disorganized in these lands, but new leaders have risen among them.  Rallying them.

To preserve our holdings here, these centaur leaders must be destroyed.

Bring me the head of Barak Kodobane.  He camps near the Forgotten Pools to the north.

Defeat him, then return to me.
850-accept.title: Kolkar Leaders

850-complete.name: Regthar Deathgate
850-complete.text:
Well done, $N.  The centaur are low, brutish creatures, but a few have the wit and vision to lead.  And those are the most dangerous.

Barak was such a centaur.  It is good that he is dead.
850-complete.title: Kolkar Leaders

850-progress.name: Regthar Deathgate
850-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Do you have Barak's Head for me?
850-progress.title: Kolkar Leaders

851-accept.name: Regthar Deathgate
851-accept.text:
The centaur Verog the Dervish wanders the Barrens, and will be difficult to find.  But he is based at the centaur command tent at the Stagnant Oasis to the southeast.  It may be possible to draw him to you.

Travel to the Stagnant Oasis to the southeast and attack centaur near the command tent.  It will be dangerous, but if you can kill enough centaur then they should raise an alarm.  And Verog will come.

Bring me his head and I will place it with Barak Kodobane's.
851-accept.title: Verog the Dervish

853-accept.name: Apothecary Helbrim
853-accept.text:
I have rendered the spores you gave me into an emulsion.  I must now send it to my associate, Apothecary Zamah.  If you were to carry this to her, she can offer you something from our stores of alchemical goods.

She is in the Pools of Vision, a cave beneath the shamans of Thunder Bluff.  The path to this cave is well hidden, but you may find it on the Spirit Rise bluff.

Do hurry.  This emulsion will maintain its potency for only a short time, and must be resealed and processed before then.
853-accept.title: Apothecary Zamah

853-complete.name: Apothecary Zamah
853-complete.text:
Ah, the spores from the Barrens that Helbrim was gathering.  He garnered your aid in delivering them?  Good.

And the emulsion is still potent, so you must have wasted no time in the delivery.  Well done, $c.
853-complete.title: Apothecary Zamah

853-progress.name: Apothecary Zamah
853-progress.text: You have something from Apothecary Helbrim?
853-progress.title: Apothecary Zamah

855-accept.name: Regthar Deathgate
855-accept.text:
The Kolkar are a threat to the Horde's claims in the Barrens; we must reduce the numbers of their troops.  And so, I have a bounty task for you.

While in Kolkar territories, slay their warriors and collect centaur bracers.  Return when you have a heap of bracers and the Horde will reward you well.
855-accept.title: Centaur Bracers

855-complete.name: Regthar Deathgate
855-complete.text:
Nicely done.  I'm sure you've struck fear into the surviving centaurs, $N.  If they have sense, they'll now calm themselves and stop their advances.

But I don't think they will, and that is unfortunate.

Unfortunate...for them.
855-complete.title: Centaur Bracers

865-accept.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
865-accept.text:
The raptors of the Barrens are smarter than raptors in other lands.  And I think all that smarts is hiding in their horns!  If so, then I could grind their horns into powder and use it to make "smart drinks."  I could sell them for a fortune!!!

And you can help me.  Find me intact raptor horns from sunscale scytheclaws.  They roam in the southern Barrens, and in the northern Barrens near the border of Ashenvale Forest.
865-accept.title: Raptor Horns

867-accept.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
867-accept.text:
The blasted harpies have been ravaging our caravan supplies for too long. It's time we slit a few of their throats and diminished their numbers.

I've been snooping around their nests and figured out who leads who. The most devastating attack will destroy a good section of their lower chain of command and then we can work our way to the top.

I'll start you off slow, take out Witchwing Harpies and Witchwing Roguefeathers in the Northwest and bring me 8 Witchwing talons. That should be a good start...
867-accept.title: Harpy Raiders

868-accept.name: Korran
868-accept.text:
Hey, $N. I been sent to the Crossroads to watch over the land and take note of its happenings for my masters in Orgrimmar.

One object of my studies are the insect-like creatures found to the south in the Field of Giants. We know little of the creatures, so I be makin' it a point to discover more. They seem to have intelligence to them, more so than any normal animal.

Take this digging claw and collect some of the creatures' eggs from their mounds, but be careful: if alerted, they will attack you.
868-accept.title: Egg Hunt

869-accept.name: Gazrog
869-accept.text:
Not long ago, a shipment of silver was stolen from our guard tower.  It was meant as payroll to the Crossroads' guards, and we want that silver back.

The strange thing is... we caught one of the thieves on the night of the theft.  And... it was a raptor!  Unbelievable!

I don't know what raptors would want with silver.  But I don't care -- I want the raptors dead so they won't steal from us again!

Hunt raptors in the Barrens.  Collect for me their heads!
869-accept.title: Raptor Thieves

869-complete.name: Gazrog
869-complete.text:
You got rid of the raptors!

Thank you, $N.  You are a $c of worth.
869-complete.title: Raptor Thieves

870-accept.name: Tonga Runetotem
870-accept.text:
Long ago, the Barrens was a lush place, teeming with life.  But war and cataclysm raged across the land, scorching it and leaving a dry husk.  Such is the way of things, and it saddens my heart.

But within the past few years, new oases have formed in the Barrens, and life stirs.  And deep down, we druids sense a power leaking its way to the surface.

We must find its source.  Travel to the Forgotten Pools, northwest of the Crossroads.  Search its waters for a source of power, then return here.
870-accept.title: The Forgotten Pools

870-complete.name: Tonga Runetotem
870-complete.text:
You found a fissure in the earth, with gases bubbling from it?  Strange.  This may be an answer to our questions, but we cannot yet be sure.

But it is a clue.  And I am grateful that you found it.
870-complete.title: The Forgotten Pools

871-accept.name: Thork
871-accept.text:
All the quilboars are our enemies, $N. Some just prove to be more of a nuisance than others.

The Razormane tribe has been attacking our supply lines from Durotar, causing us no end of annoyance. I have scouts seeking the leader of these raids, but until then, any losses you can inflict on the filthy pig men would aid us.

Start in the northeast towards Durotar. You can always tell their dens from the huge thorny vines that come up from the earth. Seek them out, and slay them.
871-accept.title: Disrupt the Attacks

871-complete.name: Thork
871-complete.text: You have done well, $N. Those insolent quilboars will finally learn that the might of the Horde is not to be ignored.
871-complete.title: Disrupt the Attacks

872-accept.name: Thork
872-accept.text:
One of my scouts witnessed an attack on a caravan from Durotar, $N. The culprits are indeed the Razormane tribe of quilboars. One of the quilboars in particular is leading the raids: Kreenig Snarlsnout. He was seen northeast of here, just south of the road from Durotar. If the threat is to be ended, then Kreenig must die.

To be sure the attacks cease, though, I say we add insult to their injury. Kill Kreenig along with more of their tribe, and return to me when you have his tusk.
872-accept.title: The Disruption Ends

872-complete.name: Thork
872-complete.text:
Well done, $N. With Kreenig's death, there will be a definite decline in the attacks on our caravans.

Your people should be proud to count you among them.
872-complete.title: The Disruption Ends

872-progress.name: Thork
872-progress.text:
Cut off the head of their leader, and chaos ensues, $N. Learn this lesson well. It will aid you in the future.

The boars will flounder without direction, and we will be able to take back the Barrens.
872-progress.title: The Disruption Ends

877-accept.name: Tonga Runetotem
877-accept.text:
Like the one you found at the Forgotten Pools, there may be fissures at the other oases in the Barrens.  If so, then perhaps the fissures are the oases' source of life.

We must test this.

Here, take these seeds.  They are dead and infertile, but take them to the Stagnant Oasis to the southeast.  If there is a fissure there, then place the seeds within it...and observe.
877-accept.title: The Stagnant Oasis

878-accept.name: Mangletooth
878-accept.text:
You must strike my enemies. <snort> You must help Mangletooth and the Razormane by weakening the Bristlebacks. Both tribes are very spiritual--tied to the earth and its power. <snort> It gives us strength in all things... especially war.

If you want to find out who really causes Thork <snort> and the Horde such anguish, then help Mangletooth! You attack the spiritual leaders of the Bristlebacks to the north; weaken them so the Razormanes can defeat them and rule the Barrens.
878-accept.title: Tribes at War

886-accept.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
886-accept.text:
The druids of Thunder Bluff sense a strange power leaking into the Barrens, east of Mulgore.

Tonga Runetotem was sent to discover the source of this power, but we fear he will need aid.

Travel to the Barrens and speak with Tonga.  He will be at the Crossroads.  To reach there, take the road east out of Bloodhoof village.  Enter the Barrens, then turn north when the road forks.  Continue north and  you will find the Crossroads.

And do not leave the road, $N, for the Barrens is a harsh land.
886-accept.title: The Barrens Oases

886-complete.name: Tonga Runetotem
886-complete.text:
My brethren in Thunder Bluff were wise to send you, young $c.  For the mystery of the Barrens is one that I alone cannot unravel.

With your aid, let us hope we can find answers to our questions.
886-complete.title: The Barrens Oases

887-accept.name: Gazlowe
887-accept.text:
I sure wish Vice Admiral Grezzlik did a better job of keeping the seas safe for our trading vessels. With all the gold the trade princes have poured into the Trade Fleets, it ticks me off to see so many pirates running willy-nilly, raiding my ships and stealing my goods!

I heard that the Southsea Freebooters have set up a camp just south of here. They've been a real thorn in my side and if Grezzlik won't take care of them, well, maybe you can help me get rid of them.
887-accept.title: Southsea Freebooters

887-complete.name: Gazlowe
887-complete.text:
You did good, kid. A little more work like that, and it'll be one less thing I'll have to worry about. Hopefully they'll be convinced that they should relocate their operation elsewhere.

In the meantime, there is the small matter of getting back the goods they stole from me!
887-complete.title: Southsea Freebooters

888-accept.name: Gazlowe
888-accept.text:
While I'd like to recover all my goods, I'm sure that's not possible. Still, there's a few things that I absolutely must have!

As you see, my observatory is ready to go, but it needs the smaller of the two lenses. The first arrived by caravan from Durotar, but the second was bound by ship, and never arrived. Also, I never got my boot shipment from Drizzlik in Booty Bay!

Head down to the pirate camp and see if you can find them.
888-accept.title: Stolen Booty

890-accept.name: Gazlowe
890-accept.text:
I've been waiting forever for my last shipment of goods from Booty Bay! I'm pretty sure that it must have been stolen by the Freebooters, but just to make sure, will you go down to the dockside and ask Dizzywig if my goods were already put into my warehouse without my knowledge?

Here, take my ledger down to Dizzywig and have him double check my inventory records against his logs.
890-accept.title: The Missing Shipment

890-complete.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
890-complete.text:
Ah, Gazlowe sent you, did he? Just a moment, let me take a look here and check my own logs and make sure I didn't have Gazlowe's shipment sent to the wrong place.

Bet he's waiting for those boots from Drizzlek...
890-complete.title: The Missing Shipment

890-progress.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
890-progress.text: Wares to send on the next ship, $N?
890-progress.title: The Missing Shipment

891-accept.name: Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun
891-accept.text:
Yet another ship from my fleet has been lost to those overzealous humans at Northwatch Hold!

Those bastards must be dealt with. Their paranoia has them in a state of frenzy. Trigger happy, reckless louts are shooting at anything in their sights.

Travel south along the Merchant Coast to the Hold and lay siege to their forces. Bring me the medals of their soldiers as proof. And for the love of my fleet, slay Captain Fairmount and her overzealous cannoneers!
891-accept.title: The Guns of Northwatch

892-accept.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
892-accept.text:
Everything looks square from my records, $N. Go on back and tell Gazlowe he's out of luck. I wouldn't be surprised if it was the pirates that nabbed his goodies.

Nothing else I can do for him. Oh... though you could tell him that I've got some things from Undermine for him, when he has the time to come pick them up.
892-accept.title: The Missing Shipment

892-complete.name: Gazlowe
892-complete.text:
No dice, eh? I guess it must have been the Freebooters then... Dizzywig's on the level, I'm sure he wouldn't cheat me like that. After all, he is on the payroll.

Looks like I've got some goods to get back, $N. What do you say?
892-complete.title: The Missing Shipment

892-progress.name: Gazlowe
892-progress.text: So, what did Dizzywig have to say?
892-progress.title: The Missing Shipment

894-accept.name: Sputtervalve
894-accept.text:
The Venture Company set up a small research facility far to the north of here, southwest of the Sludge Fen. I don't know very much about what they're doing, but did manage to discover that they're experimenting with something called a "samophlange".

Now what the heck is a samophlange? Well, whatever it is, I want to examine it, so I need someone to go get it.

I obtained a copy of their control system operating manual, you should be able to figure out how to disengage the samophlange from it.
894-accept.title: Samophlange

895-accept.name: Unknown
895-accept.text:
WANTED!

Baron Longshore, Captain of the Heedless

Captain Longshore of Gilneas leads vessels of the Southsea Freebooters, and is wanted on charges of piracy. Remains must be in identifiable condition!

-- Gazlowe
895-accept.title: WANTED: Baron Longshore

895-complete.name: Gazlowe
895-complete.text:
Ahhhh! That sort of business. You know, I saw the Heedless once on the open seas. Fearsome ship, or was that boat... those sailors are so particular!

Anyways, watching her glide across the water was quite a sight to see. I'm glad her infamous captain will trouble my ships no longer.
895-complete.title: WANTED: Baron Longshore

895-progress.name: Gazlowe
895-progress.text: What's happening? Something I can help you with? Goods to ship, perhaps an engineering job?
895-progress.title: WANTED: Baron Longshore

896-accept.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
896-accept.text:
Being Wharfmaster of a busy port like Ratchet, I keep my finger on the pulse of information. I know all about the exchange of goods and money between here and Booty Bay.

The latest bit of news I've heard is about the Venture Company's Boulder Lode mine northeast of the Sludge Fen. One of the miners discovered an emerald the size of your fist. I know a few buyers who'd be interested in getting their hands on something like that, and I'd be willing to go half and half on its sale.
896-accept.title: Miner's Fortune

899-accept.name: Mankrik
899-accept.text:
Perhaps you know the pain of uncertainty, perhaps not, $c. But know this: I stand here every day, from the sun's rising till its decline, scouring the horizon for more of those monsters. I've killed every pig man I've come across since, but my thirst for their blood is far from quenched. Perhaps instead of heading north to the Crossroads I should have headed to Taurajo.

You, $c--you  could help me.

Kill them. Kill as many as you can. Bring me their tusks, and we will celebrate their deaths together.
899-accept.title: Consumed by Hatred

903-accept.name: Sergra Darkthorn
903-accept.text:
Now it's time to go after something that really bites.  The prowlers of the Barrens are a tough breed.  Tough, resourceful, sly... and deadly.  You'll find them among the tall grasses.  You'll find many to the southwest of the Crossroads.

Be wary as you hunt them, $N, or you may find yourself no longer the predator, but instead the prey.
903-accept.title: Prowlers of the Barrens

92643-complete.name: Dead Cultist
92643-complete.text: <This man is clearly dead, killed by the assassins that you fought outside the house. As you kneel down to inspect the body you notice the glinting reflection of something shiny...>
92643-complete.title: The Turncoat

92644-accept.name: Dead Cultist
92644-accept.text: <You reach beneath the still-warm body of the turncoat cultist and recover a small, glowing blue crystal. It appears to be damaged, but it may still be important. High Elder Shadowsong may be interested in this.>
92644-accept.title: Unfortunate News

92706-accept.name: Unknown
92706-accept.text:
Calling all anglers!

A giant shark has been circling the waters near the shipping dock, attacking sailors and small boats. Dockworkers have given it the nickname "Bruuz". A hefty reward will be given to whoever brings me its fin!

-- Gazlowe
92706-accept.title: WANTED: Bruuz

92706-complete.name: Gazlowe
92706-complete.text:
Finally, somebody killed that thing! Do you know how hard it is to get a crew in the water when everyone in town's crying "Shark!"all the time?

I might just put that monster's fin into a soup for dinner tonight, just to have the last laugh.
92706-complete.title: WANTED: Bruuz

92706-progress.name: Gazlowe
92706-progress.text: What can I do for ya, $r?
92706-progress.title: WANTED: Bruuz

93459-complete.name: Vayn Moongaze
93459-complete.text: As promised, here is your reward.
93459-complete.title: More Al'Aketh Ears

93739-accept.name: Thrall
93739-accept.text:
Azeroth is a large world, and the territory of the Horde is vast. The Undercity, Orgrimmar, and Thunder Bluff all have very unique people and culture.

If you are to be a guest of the horde here on Azeroth, it would do you good to visit each of our capital cities in turn. Speak with my advisor Nazgrel for directions.
93739-accept.title: Exploring the Horde

94911-accept.name: Muln Earthfury
94911-accept.text:
Greetings, young $r. I can see that you have much promise in the druidic arts. There is one who you may want to speak with in the city of Thunder Bluff by the name of Turak Runetotem. He will teach you how to reach the stronghold of the Cenarion Circle on Kalimdor, Moonglade. 

You will be welcomed there, and the druids of the circle will impart their knowledge upon you. 

As your people would say--go with the wind's blessing, young one. I wish you good fortune in your adventures.
94911-accept.title: Child of Nature

94911-complete.name: Turak Runetotem
94911-complete.text:
A high elf, speaking to me... in Thunder Bluff. Will wonders never cease?

Well, shaper of wind, let me join our Earthen Ring brothers and sisters in welcoming you to Azeroth. My fellow druids of the Cenarion Circle have much wisdom to impart upon you, child of nature.
94911-complete.title: Child of Nature

94913-accept.name: Turak Runetotem
94913-accept.text:
All druids are welcomed to the sacred lands of Moonglade.  Keeper Remulos - Moonglade's guardian - keeps watch over all druids who hibernate there. I'll teach you the spell that lets you transport yourself there. Cast it whenever you seek Moonglade's knowledge or solace.

As for your first lesson here on Azeroth, travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven about the path you're now on. Good luck, young $c.
94913-accept.title: Moonglade

94913-complete.name: Dendrite Starblaze
94913-complete.text: Ah I see that you have already mastered the form of the Bear. Good, good. You are well on your way, young $c.
94913-complete.title: Moonglade

95349-complete.name: Alaana Stormwalker
95349-complete.text:
More adventurers from Zephras, I see. Wonderful. The winds surely favor us! It's going to take us some time to get ourselves established here, so you may want to take some time to explore this new land.

Azeroth is an exciting new world, but it's also a dangerous world. You'd do well to prepare yourself for this new adventure by familiarizing yourself with the lands nearby.
95349-complete.title: The Earthen Ring

95350-complete.name: Thrall
95350-complete.text:
Lok-tar, $c. I am Thrall, Warchief of the Horde.

An Earthen Ring messenger told me to expect members of the Windshapers, and here you are. I'd not have expected to see a high elf standing before me here in Orgrimmar, but the horde will welcome you as our guest all the same.

You have my blessing to travel through horde lands. Go with honor, Windshaper.
95350-complete.title: Welcome to Azeroth

959-accept.name: Crane Operator Bigglefuzz
959-accept.text:
Oops!

Had a little mishap, as you can see! The morning cargo shipment from Booty Bay was huge. Huge I say! Never seen so many crates. Well, I was trying to expedite things so I started unloading a bit more than I could handle. That's when everything came tumbling down.

Before I knew what was going on, I saw that menace, Mad Magglish, go running off with a bottle of 99-year-old port. Chased him all the way to Wailing Caverns. No way I was going in there.

Maybe you're brave enough to find him?
959-accept.title: Trouble at the Docks

962-progress.name: Apothecary Zamah
962-progress.text: I am eager to see if you can gather enough Serpentbloom from the Wailing Caverns. I've sent many to do my bidding but none have returned.
962-progress.title: Serpentbloom

96652-accept.name: Unknown
96652-accept.text:
<The journal appears to be quite plain, detailing the life and adventures of someone you've never heard of.

There are multiple entries mentioning camping. It seems to be quite... fun.>
96652-accept.title: The Adventurer

96821-accept.name: Vel'rin Fang
96821-accept.text:
We see fewer and fewer travelers from Razor Hill these days. The scorpids were never much fun, but now I hear there are spiders making their nest along the road.

If your travels take you up north, kill some of the spiders on your way. Then, let Razor Hill know the path's a bit safer for them.
96821-accept.title: Legging It

96821-complete.name: Gar'Thok
96821-complete.text: The peons have been scared to travel south for some time, $N. Now that you've cleared the path a bit, we can get them back to work.
96821-complete.title: Legging It

96822-accept.name: Turroc
96822-accept.text:
We lost many brave warriors of the Horde when we sacked Tiragarde Keep. Now that the humans have reinforced the ruins, we cannot collect their remains to properly honor their deaths.

Go to the ruins surrounding the keep, and search for the weapons left by our fallen kin. We will display them in a place of honor.
96822-accept.title: For Honor

96822-complete.name: Turroc
96822-complete.text: These warriors will always be remembered, $N. You have made sure of that.
96822-complete.title: For Honor

96822-progress.name: Turroc
96822-progress.text: Have you done what I asked?
96822-progress.title: For Honor

96825-accept.name: Cook Torka
96825-accept.text:
Our hunters and fishers bring back plenty of savory food for our troops - but it's rare that they get a sweet treat.

I've seen a cactus that produces a prickly, tasty fruit. But it only grows in the hills to the west, where the wretched quilboars make their camps. Make your way past the quilboars and bring me some of those fruits. And be careful - the fruits are as spiny as the quilboars!
96825-accept.title: This Fruit Could Bite Back

97003-accept.name: Gur'ak
97003-accept.text:
You there, $c. I need your aid. There are rumors of a beast that makes its lair deep in a cave at Thorn Hill, northeast of here. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or "The Ravener". It's supposedly five times the size of a normal quilboar with a thirst for blood that can never be sated.

Most don't believe the tales. But I do--because I've fought its like before.

Seek out its lair and slay Chol'aruk. Bring me its head. I warn you though--prepare well and do not go alone.

Blood and thunder, $c.
97003-accept.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener

97003-complete.name: Gur'ak
97003-complete.text:
Impressive, $c. None will doubt my tales when I return to Orgrimmar with this grim proof of the existence of these abominations. Rest assured this glory is yours however, and I will speak loudly of your deeds.

Lok-tar!
97003-complete.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener

97003-progress.name: Gur'ak
97003-progress.text:
It took the strength of six skilled fighters to defeat one of these creatures, and it still managed to fell four of us before we could put it down.

If these monstrous beasts were to appear in greater numbers, the damage that the qullboar could inflict upon the land could be catastrophic.
97003-progress.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener

97223-accept.name: Xar'Ti
97223-accept.text:
All of the raptors you see before you are ones I have trained myself. They come from all over Kalimdor, but some of the finest come from the Bloodtalon raptors on the isles off our coast.

One raptor amongst them, the Bloodtalon Matriarch, is particularly savage and has killed many from our village and has become too dangerous to leave at our borders. If you can strike her down, return with her eggs so that we can raise the hatchlings as allies instead of enemies.
97223-accept.title: Bloodtalon Matriarch

97225-accept.name: Master Vornal
97225-accept.text:
When we fled the isles that Zalazane and his ilk now inhabit, we left behind many precious idols that help us commune with spirits we worship: our loa. They are of grave importance to our tribe.

The followers of Zalazane show no reverence for our loa and have scattered these idols across the largest of the isles.

This is an action that will not go unnoticed if we are not able to collect these idols, and offending a loa is a grave matter.

Go, find as many loa idols as you can and return them to me.
97225-accept.title: Forgotten Loa Idols

97242-accept.name: Kor'geld
97242-accept.text:
Yelmak doesn't want his apprentice breaking anything. Well, anything more than he already has.

He told me the young mixer in training has too much pride to ask for help when he really needs it. Yelmak wants to give him a taste of a particular home-brewed recipe.

Gather a mix of cattail and speargrass cuttings taken from the plants growing around the water in the Valley of Honor. I'd get them myself, but if I left the shop, Whuut would surely know we're catering to his mood.
97242-accept.title: Yelmak's Medley

97246-accept.name: Thatog
97246-accept.text:
My son, Migi, always takes off to play with his friends all day. I tell him to pick up a lunch at Borstan's, but I know he almost never does, because he comes home starving. These kids think their games are more important than their own bodies!

Please, stop at Borstan's Firepit and tell him you're there to deliver Migi's lunch. You can almost certainly find Migi behind Grommash Hold with the rest of his friends.

Duties keep me here during the day and I can't watch over his every meal.
97246-accept.title: Meal Appeal

97246-complete.name: Borstan
97246-complete.text:
Of course. Migi's parents and I have an arrangement to give Migi a bagged lunch every day, but I can only ensure the boy gets his food if he actually comes in to pick it up.

Sometimes, he doesn't pick up his meal multiple times a week, and I wonder where he gets the energy to stay out and play.
97246-complete.title: Meal Appeal

97249-accept.name: Borstan
97249-accept.text:
Now that I know his parents worry about how much he's actually filling that belly, I've got an idea. 

They made me promise not to pack the same meal every day, so Migi grows a taste for more than one thing. Still, whenever the smoker's full and we're making sweetglazed hog belly sandwiches, he always shows up for lunch. We've started crumbling the leftover crispy glazed bits as a topping--something we can add daily. 

Take this to him. Maybe he'll start showing up early and bringing friends!
97249-accept.title: Favorite Food

97249-complete.name: Migi
97249-complete.text:
Borstan's Meats? Is that for one of us?

Oh!

Wow... this smells really good! Yummy.

Thanks for bringing me my lunch. I can tell what Borstan is going to be serving daily when my friends and I walk the road to Grommash Hold, by the smells alone. This tastes like my favorite, the sweetglaze! But it's different. I like the strong flavored crumbs.

If it's going to be this tasty every day, I think we need to stop our game to take our lunch together!
97249-complete.title: Favorite Food

97249-progress.name: Migi
97249-progress.text: I think we can win this one...
97249-progress.title: Favorite Food

97253-accept.name: Wrenix the Wretched
97253-accept.text:
Hey, got a sec?

So, apparently, nobody I've sent to deal with the recent pirate problem has come back alive. After five or six attempts I thought, "what if I sent a machine instead?" Turns out, scimitars double as screwdrivers in a pinch, and before I could redirect it home, it was already in pieces and scattered across their camp!

I need those parts back, and since this is a quick little retrieval mission, I'd wager your odds for survival are MUCH higher than the others. Whaddya say?
97253-accept.title: Parts and Pieces

97326-accept.name: Thra
97326-accept.text:
Hey! You've got time to help us out! I know you do, I can tell by the way you smiled watching the game we're playing.

This spot behind Grommash Hold is nice because it's clear enough for us to set up our figures. But what stinks is we don't have enough rocks for chairs or tables.

You're big and strong... d'ya think you could carry back some medium sized rocks, smooth enough to sit on if we need a rest?
97326-accept.title: Rocks to Rests

97326-complete.name: Thra
97326-complete.text:
How can you even hold all of those boulders!

Those are great. Most even have a nice flat side, too. Now that you carried them all the way over here we can scoot them around in the dirt, right where we want 'em.

Thanks, $N!
97326-complete.title: Rocks to Rests

97326-progress.name: Thra
97326-progress.text: It's nice to not have to always sit in the dirt!
97326-progress.title: Rocks to Rests

97485-accept.name: Eylah Sunhorn
97485-accept.text:
Blessings of An'she, friend.

We tauren have a tradition of scattering incense to the winds and I was hoping you'd be interested in honoring this tradition.

You will need to craft the incense by purchasing herbs from Nida, cedar from Nata, sinew thread from Mahu in the mid rise, and ceremonial flint and tinder from Naal on the upper rise. Once you have these items, combine them and spread them off the south facing cliff of Hunter's Rise.

You will find a mat and incense at the ceremonial site.
97485-accept.title: Traditions of the Bluff

97485-complete.name: Eylah Sunhorn
97485-complete.text:
You have done well.

I thank you for taking the time to perform one of our time-honored traditions, $r. I hope that as you travel you will find plenty of occasions you wish to give thanks for.

Should you ever wish to perform the ritual again, you should be able to repurchase the components I sent you to collect.

Go with An'she's warmth.
97485-complete.title: Traditions of the Bluff

97485-progress.name: Eylah Sunhorn
97485-progress.text:
There are many occasions one may choose to spread incense to the winds. You could be asking the Earthmother to watch over someone, bless a hunt, celebrate an occasion, or even to seek guidance from our ancestors.

Or it could be something else entirely.

Though the act is done with reverence, it is not strictly a ceremonial affair. Typically there are certain traditional steps observed when performing this act, but many tribes have differing practices.
97485-progress.title: Traditions of the Bluff

98024-accept.name: Thrall
98024-accept.text:
After journeying here from the elemental plane, the problems our lands face may seem small. Rest assured, the dangers the horde faces are very real, and you will grow formidable should you survive your service.

If you'd like to get started doing some good in our world, travel southwest to the vast lands known as the Barrens. There is a settlement there known as the Crossroads. The proud citizens there are ever in need of aid.

Go with honor, adventurer!
98024-accept.title: Journey to the Crossroads

98024-complete.name: Thork
98024-complete.text:
What's this? An elf? And you say the Warchief sent you?

<Thork grunts sharply as he looks you up and down.>

You look a little skinny to me, but it matters not. Out here you'll either thrive and survive, or you'll die. That is the way of things in these lands.
98024-complete.title: Journey to the Crossroads

99196-progress.name: Oura Stormspinner
99196-progress.text:
The Windshapers are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.

A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Windshapers for your generosity. 

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
99196-progress.title: A Donation of Wool
